rate_table_note: Rates are the schedule in 31.13.01.15E for group credit health insurance issued on the outstanding balance; the composite rate applies to all outstanding balances each month irrespective of loan duration. The rule prints the rates without a unit; the MIA's Bulletin 16-11 (April 6, 2016; a scanned image, not saved) heads the same schedule "Composite Rates Per $100 of Insured Indebtedness". The effective date is from the chapter's administrative history. The rates before June 1, 2016 were not found in a saved official text (gap). Also saved: archive/MD/2026-11-21_2756d5ab.html (MD-COMAR-31.13.01.html).
source_title: COMAR 31.13.01.15E (amended effective June 1, 2016, 43:5 Md. R. 387) (Library of Maryland Regulations)
summary: Maryland reduced its prima facie composite monthly outstanding balance rates for group credit health insurance (COMAR 31.13.01.15E) effective June 1, 2016, to $0.08 (14-day nonretroactive), $0.07 (30-day nonretroactive), $0.11 (14-day retroactive) and $0.09 (30-day retroactive). Old rates not recorded. Per Bulletin 16-11 (scanned, not saved) the amendment was proposed in the Maryland Register on December 28, 2015 and adopted March 4, 2016, after the Commissioner's 2014 loss ratio study.
